### reusable volcano plot functions to be used for all 3 timepoints

```{r}

library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# PATHS LABEL
chipseekerpath <- "/projects/daylab/yulia/ChIPseeker/chipseeker_infiles/Shannon_VolcanoPlots"
outPath <- "/projects/daylab/yulia/ChIPseeker/chipseeker_outfiles/Shannon_VolcanoPlots"

chipseeker.L1 <- read.csv(file.path(chipseekerpath, "G4_DEG_overlap_L1.csv"))

chipseeker.RA <- read.csv(file.path(chipseekerpath, "G4_DEG_overlap_RA.csv"))

# filter padj < 0.05
chipseeker.L1_sig <- chipseeker.L1[chipseeker.L1$padj < 0.05, ]
chipseeker.RA_sig <- chipseeker.RA[chipseeker.RA$padj < 0.05, ]

# write out filtered versions to input path
write.csv(chipseeker.L1_sig, file.path(chipseekerpath, "G4_DEG_overlap_L1_padj.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(chipseeker.RA_sig, file.path(chipseekerpath, "G4_DEG_overlap_RA_padj.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

promoter_genes.L1 <- unique(na.omit(chipseeker.L1_sig$SYMBOL))
promoter_genes.RA <- unique(na.omit(chipseeker.RA_sig$SYMBOL))

# genes of interest to label in plot
genes_to_label <- c("inx-3", "meg-1", "meg-2", "meg-3", "meg-4")

############################
# VOLCANO PLOT FUNCTION

# make plot and label the genes of interest. is flexible on including enhancer genes
make_volcano <- function(res_df, timepoint_label, promoter_genes, enhancer_genes = NULL,
                         include_enhancer = FALSE, outPath = NULL, genes_to_label) {
# order by p-value ascending
  res_df <- res_df[order(res_df$pvalue, decreasing = TRUE), ]

  if (include_enhancer && !is.null(enhancer_genes)) {

    # SET 2: PROMOTER / ENHANCER / OVERLAP / DE / NS
    res_df$color <- case_when(
      res_df$SYMBOL %in% promoter_genes & res_df$SYMBOL %in% enhancer_genes ~ "royalblue",
      res_df$SYMBOL %in% promoter_genes                                      ~ "mediumpurple3",
      res_df$SYMBOL %in% enhancer_genes                                      ~ "forestgreen",
      abs(res_df$log2FoldChange) > 0.5 | res_df$pvalue < 0.0001             ~ "darkorange",
      TRUE                                                                    ~ "grey40"
    )

    color_order <- c("grey40", "darkorange", "forestgreen", "mediumpurple3", "royalblue")
    res_df <- res_df[order(factor(res_df$color, levels = color_order)), ]

    keyvals <- res_df$color
    names(keyvals)[keyvals == "royalblue"]     <- "Promoter and enhancer associated DEG"
    names(keyvals)[keyvals == "mediumpurple3"] <- "ChIPseeker promoter-associated DEG"
    names(keyvals)[keyvals == "forestgreen"]   <- "Enhancer associated"
    names(keyvals)[keyvals == "darkorange"]    <- "Significant DEG"
    names(keyvals)[keyvals == "grey40"]        <- "Non-significant"

  } else {

    # SET 1: PROMOTER / DE / NS
    res_df$color <- case_when(
      res_df$SYMBOL %in% promoter_genes                                      ~ "mediumpurple3",
      abs(res_df$log2FoldChange) > 0.5 | res_df$pvalue < 0.0001             ~ "darkorange",
      TRUE                                                                    ~ "grey40"
    )

    color_order <- c("grey40", "darkorange", "mediumpurple3")
    res_df <- res_df[order(factor(res_df$color, levels = color_order)), ]

    keyvals <- res_df$color
    names(keyvals)[keyvals == "mediumpurple3"] <- "ChIPseeker promoter-associated DEG"
    names(keyvals)[keyvals == "darkorange"]    <- "Significant DEG"
    names(keyvals)[keyvals == "grey40"]        <- "Non-significant"
  }

  # LABEL GENES OF INTEREST REGARDLESS OF CATEGORY
  suffix <- if (include_enhancer) "_promoter_enhancer" else "_promoter_only"

  volcano <- EnhancedVolcano(res_df,
    lab             = res_df$SYMBOL,
    selectLab       = genes_to_label,
    x               = "log2FoldChange",
    y               = "pvalue",
    xlim = c(-15, 18),
    ylim = c(0, 125),
    pCutoff         = 0.05,
    FCcutoff        = 0.5,
    title           = paste0(timepoint_label, " "),
    subtitle        = NULL,
    caption         = NULL,
    labSize         = 3.5,
    cutoffLineCol   = "grey40",
    drawConnectors  = FALSE,
    widthConnectors = 0.25,
    colCustom       = keyvals,
    max.overlaps    = Inf,
    legendLabSize   = 7,
    legendIconSize  = 3
  ) +
    theme(plot.title        = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
          legend.position   = "bottom",
          legend.direction  = "vertical",
          legend.text       = element_text(size = 7),
          legend.key.size   = unit(0.4, "cm"),
          aspect.ratio       = 1)
  
  # make border for the outside of genes_to_label points
  highlight_df <- res_df[res_df$SYMBOL %in% genes_to_label, ]

  volcano <- volcano +
    geom_point(data = highlight_df,
              aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(pvalue)),
              shape = 21, size = 1, stroke = 0.8,
              colour = "black", fill = NA)

  # force vertical stacking
  volcano <- volcano +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(ncol = 1),
           color  = guide_legend(ncol = 1))
  
  if (!is.null(outPath)) {
    ggsave(file.path(outPath, paste0(timepoint_label, suffix, "_volcano.pdf")),
           plot = volcano, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)
    ggsave(file.path(outPath, paste0(timepoint_label, suffix, "_volcano.png")),
           plot = volcano, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  }

  return(volcano)
}




```



## L1

```{r}
fpath <- "/projects/daylab/yulia/RNA-Seq/DESeq/DESeq_Results_L1vsRA/"
resLFC <- read.csv(file.path(fpath, "DESeq2_L1vsRA.csv"))
colnames(resLFC)[colnames(resLFC) == "X"] <- "SYMBOL"
resLFC$log2FoldChange <- -resLFC$log2FoldChange

#enhancer.L1_genes <- unique(gsub(" .*$", "", readLines( " ")))

## SET 1: PROMOTER ONLY
make_volcano(resLFC, "L1",
             promoter_genes   = promoter_genes.L1,
             include_enhancer = FALSE,
             outPath          = outPath,
             genes_to_label   = genes_to_label)
```
